source.title: A New Light
source.objective: Receive the Seal of the Dawn.
source.progress:
Each time we empower your seal, we take a step towards ending Kel'Thuzad's incursion.

Stay strong, and we'll have freed Azeroth from the Lich King and his lieutenants in no time.
source.completion: You're a true hero, <name>. The Ashbringer himself would have been impressed.
